name: Pay In Call V 02
definition: The PayInCall message is sent by a central settlement system to request additional funding from a settlement member impacted by a failure situation.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Party for which the PayInCall is generated.

ReportData.name: Report Data
ReportData.definition: Contains the report generation information and the report items.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: To indicate the requested CLS Settlement Session that the related trade is part of.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
